houseStyle: 细纸纹、哑光水粉、剪纸轮廓、深松绿和暖奶油底，橘杏点缀。无文字、数字、品牌。可见条件用代码控制。
pairReview: 保持三组同张纸角的位置、材色和既有折痕。俯视可找褶线走向，侧视清楚看同一处的隆起；不将模拟图当触感或耐拉。碎片、纸浆、湿网、干纸小图一眼可辨。

assets.description: Directly above a single rectangular tan kraft sheet that was lightly crumpled then spread out. One distinct crease from lower left to upper middle, raised right rear corner, not torn, edges fully in view. Same sheet as row 2 col 1.
Directly above a pale gray newsprint sheet with unreadable broad pale gray print bands and loose folds, no text glyphs. Same sheet as row 2 col 2, tiny raised front left flap and right edge curl.
Directly above one clean bright ivory copy paper with crossing creases in a shallow V and one raised left tip, no ink. Same sheet as row 2 col 3.
True low orthographic side elevation of the same tan kraft sheet in row 1 col 1. Show low body with a clearly raised right corner and a visible ridge belonging to the same crease, correct tan tone.
True low orthographic side elevation of the same pale gray newsprint sheet in row 1 col 2. One low front-left flap and curled right edge, no newly introduced bends or page pieces.
True low orthographic side elevation of the same ivory copy paper in row 1 col 3. Its left tip lifts, cross-ridge projects above the table. No additional pieces or changes of color.
Isolated original pine green paper workshop camera with a circular ochre lens, simple silhouette, no letters.
Quiet clean matte paper atelier worktop texture in muted warm brown, no objects or bright pattern.

Three original quiet mini-illustrations with obvious separation: a rectangle kraft sheet and its lightly crumpled spread sheet; an adult gently tears a small clean scrap; a magnifier reveals fibrous torn edge. No copying the textbook setup or lettering.
A shallow cream tray holding clean ivory waste paper torn into many irregular dry scraps; silhouette stands apart from a bowl and a screen. No letters.
One warm ochre bowl containing wet pale paper pulp, wood stirrer raised over soft wet gray mixture. Shallow clear rim, distinguish from flat screen.
One square wooden mould and visibly fine mesh with a thin, wet uneven fibrous sheet, several drops below mesh. No writing or paper packet.
One dry, lifted ivory handmade sheet with deckled edges held above a plain pine slatted drying rack. No droplets. Clear separation from wet mesh.
Tiny apricot delivery cart with one recognizable folded-paper emblem and two round pine wheels, facing right. Simple silhouette.
Same apricot cart as adjacent cell, same two wheels and direction, active pose with a single pale mint bubble clear of wheels. No text.
Flat quiet paper studio board texture, warm ivory and pine, no items, walls, arrows or labels.
Original school paper craft table with one simple folded paper parcel, a sheet with abstract nontext print blocks, and a few folded thin white tissues. Warm illustration, no logos.

Four separate flat samples in left-to-right order kraft tan, pale gray abstract print blocks newsprint, bright ivory unprinted copy paper, thin slightly folded ivory tissue. Different edge thickness and surface texture. No words.
Two equal paper strips over a shallow safe basin on a family desk, one notebook with two rough observed marks and no wording, no addresses or electricity.
Two quiet original scenes in one card: tissue wiping a small drop at a school exhibition table, and tan kraft gift pouch carrying a tiny wood block. No letters or fragile weight.

Two adult hands hold opposite sides of two visibly equal-width looped paper strips, tan kraft and pale ivory copy, interlinked like two chain links; hands not pinching the shared contact point. Safe tidy close crop.
High-magnification macro of one smooth machine-cut ivory paper edge, clean straight line, no visible fuzzy fringe; dark pine background.
High-magnification macro of one new ivory torn paper edge, very small fine wispy exposed fibers projecting irregularly from ragged edge; dark pine background, no actual print.
Macro of only the middle of a paper sheet with simple muted ink shapes, edges out of frame and no exposed torn fibers; pine green mat border.
One soft cream tissue sample with a visibly opened gap after a pull test, paper recognizable as tissue, no tools or pouch.
One pale gray test strip with abstract faded print blocks, clearly separated torn ends from the same strip. No readable letters.
One continuous warm tan kraft test strip held lightly under tension across small smooth holders, same width as other two, no gap. No bag drawing; this is the evidence.
New scene, an intact thin wet paper layer lies safely on a plain cloth by a bright indoor window to dry, a small wooden clothes rack in background, no person or sunbeam hazards.
New scene, adult hands tear a clean left-over pastel sheet into scraps over a shallow basket, no water or mesh.
New scene, an adult gently stirs very small paper scraps in a muted green bowl with a wooden utensil, no screen or dry sheet.
